reports.dimension_interpretation: Across the four native patient geometries, the K2_C0001–K2_C0002 boundary is only weakly represented. RNA (silhouette 0.079, negative fraction 0.282) and WXS (silhouette 0.091, negative fraction 0.262) show the clearest, though still weak, within-versus-between separation, with between-label distances modestly exceeding within-label distances. CT (silhouette 0.013, negative fraction 0.437) and WSI (silhouette 0.050, negative fraction 0.456) show near-zero separation, with between-label distances only marginally larger than within-label distances and nearly half of patients having negative silhouettes. Synthesizing jointly rather than by vote counting, the overall native-view pattern provides weak and partially conflicting evidence for the current boundary: two modalities (RNA, WXS) weakly express the boundary while two (CT, WSI) show essentially no distinction. No nearest competing set is reported for any modality.
reports.cross_evidence_context: The biological_support reports for K2_C0001 and K2_C0002 describe reciprocal set-versus-rest transcriptomic phenotypes, a different evidence role (identity) than this pair-scope boundary geometry. evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K2_C0001 shows a coherent, interpretable transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the partition. The dominant up-regulated programs are oxidative phosphorylation (NES 2.29, FDR 0.001), interferon gamma/alpha responses, allograft rejection, DNA repair, ROS, mTORC1, complement, IL6/JAK/STAT3, glycolysis, E2F targets, and G2M checkpoint, with several immune/inflammatory and metabolic programs also up. Down-regulated programs include UV response DN (NES -1.86), WNT beta-catenin, TGF-beta, and Hedgehog signaling. evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K2_C0001 shows a coherent, interpretable transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the partition. The dominant up-regulated programs are oxidative phosphorylation (NES 2.29, FDR 0.001), interferon gamma/alpha responses, allograft rejection, DNA repair, ROS, mTORC1, complement, IL6/JAK/STAT3, glycolysis, E2F targets, and G2M checkpoint, with several immune/inflammatory and metabolic programs also up. Down-regulated programs include UV response DN (NES -1.86), WNT beta-catenin, TGF-beta, and Hedgehog signaling. The pattern is internally consistent (oxidative phosphorylation, ROS, and interferon programs share leading-edge genes such as COX/NDUF/ATP synthase subunits and interferon-stimulated genes), indicating a distinct molecular program rather than a diffuse signal.
